item.title: Rang Panchami 2026: Know Significance, Puja Vidhi and Why It Is Celebrated After Holi
item.description: The festival of Rang Panchami is considered very special in Hinduism. It is celebrated on the Ashtami (eighth day) of the Krishna Paksha (dark fortnight) of the month of Chaitra. In fact, the Holi festival lasts for five days. Rang Panchami is the last day of this five-day festival. It is also known as Dev Panchami or Shri Panchami.
